placements.why: No existing strata category covers instrument calibration/verification practice; this envelope's content (calibration result plus its verification against a reference standard) names an organizational category the repo does not yet have, so it is minted standalone with no forced parent.
placements.title: Instrument states are established through verifiable calibration procedures, not asserted alone
placements.frame: What organizational category governs claims about an instrument's calibrated or verified state?

placements.title: A calibration claim carries weight only when backed by a named verification method and reference standard
placements.frame: What verification procedure and reference standard substantiates this calibration claim, and does it hold across the full operating range?
placements.why: src-1 asserts the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibrated state and src-2 substantiates it by naming the verification method (June reference plates) and scope (full observing band) — a thematic subject future calibration envelopes will keep feeding, not a one-time fact, so it earns its own leaf under the newly minted Calibration strata rather than being folded as evidence under something else.
